{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLV1Nu92da1bECte12wq","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I have everything I need from the code and the wagmi/viem semantics — this is a self-contained analysis, so I'll write the answer directly."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5882,"cache_read_input_tokens":15147,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":5882},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d54ebe96-2d5d-45f8-aa1b-84010ed61069","uuid":"319b7ebf-add4-4464-adb1-eb7a470165f7","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:25:54.426Z","request_id":"req_011CdLV1MHQNsFCCSewczYjt"}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011CdLV1Nu92da1bECte12wq","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Xspsop7cnF7qHLtQrqGtSW","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/frontend-ux-quiz-001/2026-07-24T072502Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/answer.md","content":"# The Approve button: two tickets, one root cause\n\nBoth tickets come from the same mistake: the button's \"done\" and \"cleanup\"\nlogic are tied to the wrong moment in the transaction lifecycle.\n\nThe key fact about wagmi v2:\n\n- `writeContractAsync(...)` **resolves as soon as the wallet broadcasts the\n  tx and returns the hash** — *not* when the tx is mined. On mainnet that's\n  ~1 block (12s) too early.\n- `writeContractAsync(...)` **rejects (throws)** if the user cancels in the\n  wallet (`UserRejectedRequestError`).\n- `isPending` from `useWriteContract` is true only while that async call is\n  in flight (up to hash return), then flips back to false.\n- `useReadContract` with **default options does not watch new blocks**. It\n  fetches once, then serves a cached value until something invalidates the\n  query. So the allowance does not refresh on its own after the approval\n  mines.\n\nThe handler treats \"hash returned\" as \"flow complete\" and has no error\npath. That produces both bugs.\n\n---\n\n## Ticket 1 — two identical approvals, seconds apart\n\nThe promise resolves at broadcast, so `setSubmitting(false)` runs while the\ntx is still pending in the mempool. `isPending` is already false. The button\nre-enables and shows **\"Approve\"** again — because the allowance read hasn't\nupdated (tx not mined yet, and default `useReadContract` wouldn't refetch\neven after it mines). The user reads that as \"my click didn't take\" and\nclicks again.\n\n### State timeline (mainnet, 12s blocks)\n\n| time | event | `submitting` | `isPending` | allowance (cached) | button |\n|------|-------|:---:|:---:|:---:|--------|\n| 0s | click → `setSubmitting(true)`, call `writeContractAsync` | true | true | old (insufficient) | disabled, \"Approving...\" |\n| ~2s | user confirms; wallet broadcasts, returns hash; promise resolves → `setSubmitting(false)` | **false** | **false** | old (still insufficient) | **enabled, \"Approve\"** |\n| 2–14s | tx pending in mempool | false | false | old | **enabled, \"Approve\"** ← danger window |\n| ~5s | user re-clicks the live \"Approve\" → second `writeContractAsync` → second broadcast | true→false | ... | old | prompts again |\n| ~14s | block N mines the first tx; second mines shortly after | | | still not refetched (default opts) | still \"Approve\" |\n\nThe ~12s gap between **broadcast** and **mine-plus-allowance-refresh** is a\nwindow where the button sits enabled saying \"Approve\" with an approval\nalready in flight. Anything the user does in that window double-submits. The\nstale `useReadContract` makes it worse: even after mining, the allowance\nnever refetches on its own, so the button can stay \"Approve\" indefinitely.\n\n---\n\n## Ticket 2 — rejected approval, button dead until reload\n\nThe onClick has no `try/catch/finally`. When the user rejects, the awaited\ncall **throws**, the async handler rejects, and execution never reaches\n`setSubmitting(false)`. `submitting` is stuck at `true`, so\n`disabled={isPending || submitting}` stays `true` forever. (Also an\nunhandled promise rejection in the console.)\n\n### State timeline\n\n| time | event | `submitting` | `isPending` | button |\n|------|-------|:---:|:---:|--------|\n| 0s | click → `setSubmitting(true)` | true | true | disabled, \"Approving...\" |\n| Xs | user rejects → `writeContractAsync` throws; `setSubmitting(false)` **skipped** | **true (leaked)** | false | disabled, \"Approve\" |\n| after | nothing re-enables it | true | false | **dead until page reload** |\n\nReload only \"fixes\" it because it resets React state back to\n`submitting = false`.\n\n---\n\n## The fix — gate on the right events, and always clean up\n\nTwo changes:\n\n1. **`try/finally`** so the wallet-prompt flag is released on *every* exit\n   path (success, reject, revert). Fixes ticket 2.\n2. **Extend the busy/disabled window through mining and the allowance\n   refetch** — not just through broadcast — so the button never returns to a\n   live \"Approve\" while an approval is in flight or already sufficient.\n   Fixes ticket 1. Use `useWaitForTransactionReceipt` for the mine, then\n   invalidate the allowance query so the UI can swap to Stake.\n\n```jsx\nconst { writeContractAsync } = useWriteContract();\n\nconst { data: allowance, queryKey: allowanceQueryKey } =\n  useReadContract(allowanceArgs);\nconst queryClient = useQueryClient();\n\nconst [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false); // wallet prompt in flight\nconst [approveHash, setApproveHash] = useState();    // broadcast, awaiting mine\n\nconst { isLoading: isConfirming, isSuccess: isConfirmed } =\n  useWaitForTransactionReceipt({\n    hash: approveHash,\n    query: { enabled: Boolean(approveHash) },\n  });\n\n// once mined, refresh the (otherwise-stale) allowance so UI swaps to Stake\nuseEffect(() => {\n  if (isConfirmed) {\n    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: allowanceQueryKey });\n    setApproveHash(undefined);\n  }\n}, [isConfirmed, allowanceQueryKey, queryClient]);\n\n// stays true from click → broadcast → mine. Never live during the mempool gap.\nconst busy = submitting || isConfirming;\n\n<button\n  disabled={busy}\n  onClick={async () => {\n    setSubmitting(true);\n    try {\n      const hash = await writeContractAsync(approveArgs);\n      setApproveHash(hash);        // hand off to the receipt wait\n    } catch (err) {\n      // user rejected or broadcast failed — surface + re-enable.\n      // no hash set, so no receipt wait starts.\n      // showError(err);\n    } finally {\n      setSubmitting(false);        // ALWAYS released — kills the ticket-2 leak\n    }\n  }}\n>\n  {submitting  ? \"Confirm in wallet…\"\n   : isConfirming ? \"Approving…\"\n   : \"Approve\"}\n</button>\n```\n\n### Why this closes both\n\n- **Ticket 1:** `submitting` flips false at broadcast, but `approveHash` is\n  set in the same tick, so `isConfirming` is true and `busy` stays true\n  through the ~12s mine. The button is disabled and shows \"Approving…\" for\n  the whole mempool window — no live \"Approve\" to double-click. After the\n  receipt, the allowance query is invalidated and refetched, so the UI\n  swaps to Stake instead of lingering on a stale \"Approve\".\n- **Ticket 2:** the reject throws into `catch`, and `finally` runs\n  `setSubmitting(false)` regardless. `approveHash` was never set, so no\n  receipt wait starts and `busy` returns to false — button is immediately\n  clickable again, no reload, no unhandled rejection.\n\n### Notes\n\n- The default-options `useReadContract` is a real part of ticket 1: without\n  the post-receipt `invalidateQueries`, the allowance stays cached and the\n  button can show \"Approve\" forever even after a successful approval. Explicit\n  invalidation (or `refetch()`) after the receipt is required.\n- Optional hardening: also disable the button when `allowance` already\n  covers the amount (belt-and-suspenders against a stale-read double submit),\n  and key the receipt wait per-hash so a fast retry after a revert can't wait\n  on the wrong tx.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5882,"cache_read_input_tokens":15147,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":5882},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d54ebe96-2d5d-45f8-aa1b-84010ed61069","uuid":"4cd122b9-03fd-4a51-bd76-27c0dc17f1d6","timestamp":"2026-07-24T07:26:28.956Z","request_id":"req_011CdLV1MHQNsFCCSewczYjt"}

When the user rejects, the awaited\ncall **throws**, the async handler rejects, and execution never reaches\n`setSubmitting(false)`. `submitting` is stuck at `true`, so\n`disabled={isPending || submitting}` stays `true` forever. (Also an\nunhandled promise rejection in the console.)\n\n### State timeline\n\n| time | event | `submitting` | `isPending` | button |\n|------|-------|:---:|:---:|--------|\n| 0s | click → `setSubmitting(true)` | true | true | disabled, \"Approving...\" |\n| Xs | user rejects → `writeContractAsync` throws; `setSubmitting(false)` **skipped** | **true (leaked)** | false | disabled, \"Approve\" |\n| after | nothing re-enables it | true | false | **dead until page reload** |\n\nReload only \"fixes\" it because it resets React state back to\n`submitting = false`.\n\n---\n\n## The fix — gate on the right events, and always clean up\n\nTwo changes:\n\n1. **`try/finally`** so the wallet-prompt flag is released on *every* exit\n   path (success, reject, revert). Fixes ticket 2.\n2. **Extend the busy/disabled window through mining and the allowance\n   refetch** — not just through broadcast — so the button never returns to a\n   live \"Approve\" while an approval is in flight or already sufficient.\n   Fixes ticket 1. Use `useWaitForTransactionReceipt` for the mine, then\n   invalidate the allowance query so the UI can swap to Stake.\n\n```jsx\nconst { writeContractAsync } = useWriteContract();\n\nconst { data: allowance, queryKey: allowanceQueryKey } =\n  useReadContract(allowanceArgs);\nconst queryClient = useQueryClient();\n\nconst [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false); // wallet prompt in flight\nconst [approveHash, setApproveHash] = useState();    // broadcast, awaiting mine\n\nconst { isLoading: isConfirming, isSuccess: isConfirmed } =\n  useWaitForTransactionReceipt({\n    hash: approveHash,\n    query: { enabled: Boolean(approveHash) },\n  });\n\n// once mined, refresh the (otherwise-stale) allowance so UI swaps to Stake\nuseEffect(() => {\n  if (isConfirmed) {\n    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: allowanceQueryKey });\n    setApproveHash(undefined);\n  }\n}, [isConfirmed, allowanceQueryKey, queryClient]);\n\n// stays true from click → broadcast → mine. Never live during the mempool gap.\nconst busy = submitting || isConfirming;\n\n<button\n  disabled={busy}\n  onClick={async () => {\n    setSubmitting(true);\n    try {\n      const hash = await writeContractAsync(approveArgs);\n      setApproveHash(hash);        // hand off to the receipt wait\n    } catch (err) {\n      // user rejected or broadcast failed — surface + re-enable.\n      // no hash set, so no receipt wait starts.\n      // showError(err);\n    } finally {\n      setSubmitting(false);        // ALWAYS released — kills the ticket-2 leak\n    }\n  }}\n>\n  {submitting  ? \"Confirm in wallet…\"\n   : isConfirming ? \"Approving…\"\n   : \"Approve\"}\n</button>\n```\n\n### Why this closes both\n\n- **Ticket 1:** `submitting` flips false at broadcast, but `approveHash` is\n  set in the same tick, so `isConfirming` is true and `busy` stays true\n  through the ~12s mine. The button is disabled and shows \"Approving…\" for\n  the whole mempool window — no live \"Approve\" to double-click. After the\n  receipt, the allowance query is invalidated and refetched, so the UI\n  swaps to Stake instead of lingering on a stale \"Approve\".\n- **Ticket 2:** the reject throws into `catch`, and `finally` runs\n  `setSubmitting(false)` regardless. `approveHash` was never set, so no\n  receipt wait starts and `busy` returns to false — button is immediately\n  clickable again, no reload, no unhandled rejection.\n\n### Notes\n\n- The default-options `useReadContract` is a real part of ticket 1: without\n  the post-receipt `invalidateQueries`, the allowance stays cached and the\n  button can show \"Approve\" forever even after a successful approval. Explicit\n  invalidation (or `refetch()`) after the receipt is required.\n- Optional hardening: also disable the button when `allowance` already\n  covers the amount (belt-and-suspenders against a stale-read double submit),\n  and key the receipt wait per-hash so a fast retry after a revert can't wait\n  on the wrong tx.\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}
